inputs.text: Lawyers stated on Monday that worries are growing regarding proposed alterations to the surveillance legislation in Cyprus, specifically attempts to eliminate judicial oversight as an essential safeguard. The modified bill is anticipated to be presented to the House plenum for a vote on Thursday, as stated by Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides following a recent closed session of the House.
